ChangeResourceGroup.description_en: Updates the resource group of a Function Compute resource
ChangeResourceGroup.description_zh: 更新函数计算资源的资源组

CreateSession.description_en: Creates an explicit session resource. The system automatically generates a unique session ID, pre-allocates a function instance, and binds the instance to the session. You can specify the TTL and idle timeout. This operation applies to the HEADER_FIELD or GENERATED_COOKIE affinity types to implement session warm-up and configuration initialization. After the session is created, you can include the session ID in InvokeFunction requests to route requests
CreateSession.description_zh: 创建一个显式会话资源。系统自动生成唯一 SessionID，预分配函数实例并绑定会话，支持指定 TTL 和 IdleTimeout。适用于 HEADER_FIELD 或 GENERATED_COOKIE 亲和类型，实现会话预热与配置初始化，调用后即可在 InvokeFunction 请求携带，用于路由请求

CreateSnapshot.description_en: Creates a user snapshot from a normal and unexpired micro-sandbox session
CreateSnapshot.description_zh: 从正常且未过期的微沙箱会话中创建用户快照

DeleteScalingConfig.description_en: Deletes the elastic configuration of a function

DeleteSession.description_en: Deletes a specified session, blocks new request routing, and purges session metadata from the database. Subsequent requests from the client carrying the same SessionID are treated as a new session. This operation releases resources and cleans up the session. In session isolation scenarios, the system stops running requests and releases instances bound to the session. In non-session isolation scenarios, running requests continue to run and terminate gracefully
DeleteSession.description_zh: 删除指定会话，禁止新请求路由，会话元数据从数据库清除，客户携带相同 SessionID 的后续请求视为新会话。实现资源释放与会话清理。在会话隔离场景下，系统将中止运行的请求，释放会话绑定的实例。非会话隔离场景下，正在运行中的请求将继续运行，优雅终止

DeleteSnapshot.description_zh: 删除用户 MicroSandbox 快照

DeleteVpcBinding.description_en: Deletes the access control policy of a specified VPC firewall policy group
DeleteVpcBinding.description_zh: 删除指定VPC防火墙策略组的访问控制策略

DescribeRegions.description_en: Queries the regions supported by Function Compute 3.0
DescribeRegions.description_zh: 查询FC 3.0产品支持的地域信息

DisableFunctionInvocation.description_en: Disables function invocations. You can also stop all ongoing requests. When a function is disabled, new instances cannot be created and provisioned instances are destroyed. This OpenAPI is in beta
DisableFunctionInvocation.description_zh: 禁止函数被调用，可选终止所有正在处理的请求。函数被禁止调用后，将无法创建新实例，同时预留实例会被销毁。该 OpenAPI 处于内测阶段

EnableFunctionInvocation.description_en: The EnableFunctionInvocation operation allows a function to be invoked and resumes the creation of provisioned instances. This operation is currently in private preview
EnableFunctionInvocation.description_zh: 允许函数被调用，并恢复预留实例的创建。该 OpenAPI 处于内测阶段

GetAsyncInvokeConfig.description_en: Retrieves the asynchronous invocation configuration of a specified function
GetAsyncInvokeConfig.description_zh: 获取指定函数的异步调用配置

GetAsyncTask.description_en: Retrieves the details of a specified asynchronous task
GetAsyncTask.description_zh: 获取指定异步任务详情

GetCustomDomain.description_en: Retrieves the custom domain name configuration

GetFunctionCode.description_en: Retrieves the details of a function code package
GetFunctionCode.description_zh: 获取函数代码包的详情

GetLayerVersion.description_en: Retrieves information about a layer version

GetLayerVersionByArn.description_en: Retrieves the version information of a layer by its Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN)
GetLayerVersionByArn.description_zh: 通过ARN获取层的版本信息

GetScalingConfig.description_en: Retrieves the elastic configuration of a function

GetSession.description_en: Retrieves the details of a specified session, including the session ID, associated function, affinity type, lifecycle configuration, status, and instance information. This operation queries the current metadata of a single session and supports precise lookup by functionName and qualifier to facilitate monitoring and debugging by external systems. Only sessions in the Active state can be queried
GetSession.description_zh: 获取指定会话的详细信息，包括 SessionID、关联函数、亲和类型、生命周期配置、状态及实例信息。用于查询单个会话当前元数据，支持按 functionName 和 qualifier 精确定位，便于外部系统监控与调试，仅支持查询 Active 状态的会话

GetTrigger.description_en: Retrieves the details of a specified trigger
GetTrigger.description_zh: 获取指定的触发器详情

ListAsyncInvokeConfigs.description_en: Lists the asynchronous invocation configurations for one or more functions
ListAsyncInvokeConfigs.description_zh: 查询指定函数的所有异步配置信息

ListAsyncTasks.description_en: Lists the details of asynchronous tasks
ListAsyncTasks.description_zh: 获取异步任务详情列表

ListCustomDomains.description_en: Retrieves a list of custom domain names
ListCustomDomains.description_zh: 获取自定义域名信息列表

ListFunctionVersions.description_en: Lists the versions of a specified function
ListFunctionVersions.description_zh: 查询指定函数的版本列表

ListLayerVersions.description_en: Retrieves a list of layer versions

ListProvisionConfigs.description_en: Retrieves a list of provisioned configurations

ListScalingConfigs.description_en: Lists the elastic configurations of a function

ListSessions.description_en: Lists the active or expired sessions of a specified function. This operation supports filtering by qualifier, status, and session ID, and supports paging. It returns the basic property of sessions to help you view session distribution and status in batches, facilitate Service Monitoring and external system integration, and improve session visibility and management
ListSessions.description_zh: 列举指定函数下Active/Expired 状态的会话列表，支持按 qualifier、状态、会话ID过滤，分页查询。返回会话基础属性，用于批量查看会话分布与状态，助力运维监控和外部系统集成，提升会话可见性与管理能力

ListTagResources.description_zh: 列出所有被打标签的资源

ListTriggers.description_en: Queries the list of triggers for a specified function
ListTriggers.description_zh: 查询指定函数的触发器列表

PutAsyncInvokeConfig.description_en: Creates or updates the asynchronous invocation configuration for a function
PutAsyncInvokeConfig.description_zh: 创建或更新函数的异步调用配置

PutConcurrencyConfig.description_en: Sets the concurrency for a function

PutLayerACL.description_en: Modifies the permissions of a layer

PutScalingConfig.description_en: Sets the elastic configuration for a function

UpdateSession.description_en: Updates the session configuration for active sessions, such as lifecycle configurations including SessionTTLInSeconds and SessionIdleTimeoutInSeconds. The updates take effect immediately, and LastModifiedTime is automatically refreshed. This operation extends or shortens the session validity period to implement dynamic management without changing the execution environment bound to the session
UpdateSession.description_zh: 更新Active状态下的会话配置，如 SessionTTLInSeconds 和 SessionIdleTimeoutInSeconds 等生命周期配置。更新后生效，LastModifiedTime 自动刷新。可用于延长或缩短会话有效期，实现动态管理，不改变会话绑定的执行环境
